description: This file contains the implementation of the 'AttributeGroup' controller class within the OpenCart administration module. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and form handling for attribute groups in the catalog section of the admin interface.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing attribute groups in the catalog section of OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main attribute group listing page, preparing data like breadcrumbs, list of attribute groups, and URLs for actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the list of attribute groups, primarily used for AJAX calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the HTML view for the attribute groups list, including sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an attribute group, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing attribute group, validating permissions, and input data. Returns JSON with success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected attribute groups after permission checks and returns JSON success or error messages.
